# SubtitleBot

> SubtitleBot (https://www.subtitlebot.com) is a browser-based toolkit for finding, translating, editing and synchronizing subtitles. Its AI subtitle translator covers 100+ language pairs and preserves timestamps. The first complete subtitle file is translated free; afterwards you pay per use with credits, with no subscription.

## Key facts

- Subtitle finder for movies and TV series (OpenSubtitles) and anime (Jimaku): https://www.subtitlebot.com/subtitles-search
- AI subtitle translation (context-aware, based on Google Gemini models): https://www.subtitlebot.com/translate
- Supported subtitle formats: SRT, VTT, ASS, SSA, SUB, SBV and TXT (files up to 10 MB)
- Online subtitle editor with timing shift, find and replace and export: https://www.subtitlebot.com/subtitle-editor
- Free subtitle tools (sync and FPS conversion, SRT validator, reading speed, SRT/VTT conversion, encoding detection): https://www.subtitlebot.com/tools
- Video player with subtitles and subtitle overlay for streaming sites: https://www.subtitlebot.com/video-tools
- Pricing: first complete subtitle file free, then pay-as-you-go credits that never expire: https://www.subtitlebot.com/pricing
- Languages of the site: English (default) and Czech (https://www.subtitlebot.com/cs)
- Operated from Prague, Czech Republic. Support: support@subtitlebot.com

## Guides

- Subtitle guides hub: https://www.subtitlebot.com/guides
